Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the very first step of the conversation. The task asks to identify "Which film has the director who died later". The Planner correctly identified that it needs to compare the death dates of the two directors. However, in the "Final Answer" section (which the Planner generated in the last step), the Planner concluded: "The film whose director died later is The Death Kiss." This conclusion is factually incorrect based on the data the Planner itself retrieved. The data shows Edwin L. Marin (Director of The Death Kiss) died in 1951, while Maurice Elvey (Director of Her Luck in London) died in 1967. Therefore, the director of *Her Luck in London* died later. The Planner failed to perform the final comparison correctly, reversing the conclusion despite having the correct data.
